title: Parallel Computing
description: Parallel architectures, shared-memory and message-passing programming models, performance analysis, and the design of parallel algorithms.

title: Parallel and Concurrent Programming
description: Concurrency, synchronisation, deadlock, and the design of correct concurrent programs. Covers threads, locks, message passing and formal reasoning about concurrent behaviour.

title: Database Systems Implementation
description: Storage management, indexing, query processing and optimisation, transaction management and concurrency control inside a relational database engine.

title: Parallel and Distributed Algorithms
description: Distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, fault tolerance, replication, logical clocks and the impossibility results that shape practical system design.

title: Database Systems
description: Relational model, SQL, schema design, normalisation and an introduction to transaction processing.

title: Computer Networks Practice
description: Hands-on network programming: socket programming, protocol implementation, network measurement and performance troubleshooting.
